profile.headline: Senior iOS Engineer

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned delivery of two customer-facing features spanning multiple application modules, partnering
with product, design, and engineering stakeholders from planning through launch.
Contributed to a large, modular iOS codebase serving millions of users while maintaining high
standards for code quality, scalability, and user experience.

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated SwiftUI and Combine into legacy iOS codebases, enhancing
maintainability and responsiveness.
Automated CI/CD pipelines using Xcode Cloud, streamlining build, test, and
deployment workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift · SwiftUI · iOS Development · JIRA · Git

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Work together with a small team to develop and launch the alpha version of search in the iOS app.
Contribute elements to an in house design library using SwiftUI that is used by multiple iOS teams and aligns with a company wide design system. Led the “on figure imagery” feature in the iOS application, utilizing GraphQL, collaborated with cross functional teams and coordinated the release across web and mobile platforms resulting in increased sales.
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · Fastlane · Requirements Gathering · Project Planning · Unit Testing · SwiftUI · Communication · Xcode · Mobile Applications · iOS Development · Design Patterns · Mobile Architecture · Mobile Application Development · Team Motivation · Code Review · UIKit · iOS · Software Development · GraphQL

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Refactor and build upon an existing suite of tax and accounting apps with a global and multilingual user base. Coordinate with web, platform, and backend teams to align user experience across all platforms.
Contribute to an in-house multi-factor authentication app with hundreds of thousands of daily uses.
Collaborate with team members across the globe including managing handing off work, code reviews, and mentoring while taking advantage of time differences to maximize output.
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · Fastlane · Requirements Gathering · Unit Testing · Communication · Mobile Applications · Design Patterns · Mobile Architecture · CocoaPods · Mobile Application Development · Team Motivation · Code Review · UIKit · iOS · Software Development · Jenkins

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description: Developed a global native iOS application written in Swift, utilizing Carthage frameworks like Quick and Nimble for unit testing. Incorporated Extreme Programming practices such as paired programming and TDD. Contributed to Apple Watch app, increasing stability in existing app and developing new features. Participated in daily stand ups, weekly sprint planning, story/feature estimation and retrospectives.
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · Unit Testing · Communication · Mobile Applications · Design Patterns · Mobile Architecture · CocoaPods · Mobile Application Development · Code Review · UIKit · iOS · Software Development

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Wrote clean code, primarily in Swift, to build beautiful and functional apps. 
Continuously sought out ways to improve my skill set and stay up to date on advancements in iOS development. 
Utilized tools such as git, Jira, Jenkins, Charles, Cocoapods, and Basecamp to communicate and collaborate with the project team. 
Successfully completed intensive three-month apprenticeship program in Objective-C
positions.insights: Skills: Version Control · Fastlane · Unit Testing · Communication · Mobile Applications · Design Patterns · Mobile Architecture · CocoaPods · Mobile Application Development · Team Motivation · Code Review · UIKit · iOS · Software Development · Jenkins

positions.title: Digital Communications and Student Support Services
positions.description:
Coordinate graduate student support services within the College of Liberal Arts & Education.
Work with the CLAE web developer on website development and support specifically related to CLAE graduate programs.
Collaborate with the Online Learning Committee and other staff/faculty members in the development of a long-term strategic design for graduate online learning and other initiatives.
Train and support faculty to develop onsite and online learning.

positions.title: Coach
positions.description:
Coach for competitive Trampoline and Tumbling team. Develop skills and confidence in every gymnast. 
Assist children in developing balance and coordination, while encouraging a healthy and active lifestyle.

positions.title: Digital Media and Design Teacher
positions.description: I teach students a variety of technology skills well instilling in them a foundation for understanding design and the design process. In my class, students are introduced to a wide range of careers while building organizational, problem solving, and communication skills they will use for the rest of their lives.

company.name: University Prep Science and Math High School

positions.title: Production Secretary
positions.description: Handled all shipping for entire crew, created accounts with multiple vendors, filed Workers Comp claims, and managed Office PAs.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: Answer phones, copy and distribute paperwork, and problem solve while carrying out various day to day tasks.

positions.title: Post-production Assistant
positions.description:
-Production Assistant and Media Manager on short film "Hunting Blind"
-Edit trailers and teasers to fit each project's mood and purpose
-Assisted in animating "Daisy Tells a Secret" for HAVEN in AfterEffects

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
-Selected to be a Learning Coach, trained new employees
-Appointed as one of two employees to attend regional symposium

positions.title: Volunteer Curatorial Assistant
positions.description:
-Photo documented and cataloged collections, designed labels and setup exhibits
-Receptionist and tour guide
